svg.title: Distance depends on both speeds.
svg.desc: A contour map of the analytical braking distance versus initial and final speeds. No braking is needed above the equal-speed diagonal. Below it, labelled distance contours increase toward higher initial and lower final speeds.

g.text: Analytical model: a₀ = 6 m/s², b = 0.002 /m. Contours every 25 m.
The comparison plot is a slice at final speed 15 m/s. This view varies both speeds.
